show.description: A rich billionaire who does not believe in marriage agrees to have a child through IVF to protect his legacy. What starts as a practical decision soon turns into a tough journey filled with family pressure, lies, danger, and unexpected emotions. As love enters his life, he must choose between power, reputation, and the woman carrying his child. Billionaire Ka IVF Ishq is a gripping story of a man forced to fight for his family and future.
